goals.text: Find a Nether Fortress and collect Blaze Rods
goals.hint: Fortresses are long dark-brick bridges. Blazes spawn near their spawners.
goals.why: Blaze rods make brewing stands, blaze powder, eyes of ender and many machines. Wither skeletons (for the Wither boss) live in fortresses too.
steps: Explore the Nether along one axis (east/west) to find dark red brick bridges.
Find a blaze spawner (a cage with fire) and fight blazes with a shield or bow.
Snowballs hurt blazes; fire resistance makes this much safer.

mobs.where: Blazes live in Nether Fortresses, around blaze spawners (a cage with a tiny spinning blaze inside). Bring fire resistance; snowballs hurt them. Carry a spawner home with Carry On for a blaze farm.

goals.hint: A blaze powder and an ender pearl make an Eye of Ender.
An Eye of Ender in a ring of Obsidian makes an Ender Chest.

goals.text: Brew a Potion of Fire Resistance
goals.hint: Brewing stand, nether wart in water bottles, then magma cream.
goals.why: Fire resistance makes you immune to fire and lava: essential for the Nether, blaze farms and the Twilight Fire Swamp and Hydra.
steps: Craft a brewing stand (blaze rod + cobblestone) and fuel it with blaze powder.
Get nether wart from a fortress and brew it into water bottles (Awkward Potion).
Add magma cream (slime + blaze powder) for Fire Resistance. Redstone makes it last longer.

mobs.where: Blazes live in Nether Fortresses, around blaze spawners (a cage with a tiny spinning blaze inside). Bring fire resistance; snowballs hurt them. Carry a spawner home with Carry On for a blaze farm.

goals.hint: An awkward potion plus a glistering melon heals you.
Blaze powder in an awkward potion makes strength.

goals.text: Brew a Potion of Night Vision
goals.hint: Golden carrots make night vision.

goals.text: Find a Bastion and trade with Piglins
goals.hint: Wear one gold armor piece and throw gold ingots to piglins to barter.
goals.why: Piglins trade ender pearls, obsidian, fire resistance potions, quartz and more for gold. Bastions hold netherite and gold loot.
steps: Wear at least one piece of gold armor so piglins stay calm.
Throw a gold ingot to a piglin (Q) and pick up what it gives back.

mobs.where: Piglins live in Crimson Forests and the Nether Wastes and guard Bastions. Wear at least one piece of gold armor so they stay calm, then throw them gold ingots to barter.

goals.hint: Piglins ignore players wearing gold.
Crying obsidian and glowstone make a respawn anchor.

goals.text: Ride a Strider across a lava ocean
goals.hint: Saddle a Strider and steer it with warped fungus on a stick.
goals.why: A challenge: striders (saddle + warped fungus on a stick) carry you across lava safely.
goals.tip: Ordinary boats do not cross lava safely. Keep a marked return route.
steps: Bring a saddle, warped fungus on a stick, spare blocks and fire resistance.
Find a Strider beside a Nether lava sea, saddle it and mount it.
Hold warped fungus on a stick to steer across the lava, then dismount onto safe ground.

goals.text: Use Carry On to bring a Blaze Spawner home
goals.hint: Sneak-right-click the spawner with empty hands to carry it; it keeps its mob.
goals.why: A blaze spawner at home is an endless blaze rod farm: rods are needed for brewing, eyes of ender and Create brass.
steps: Clear the blazes around the spawner and empty your hands.
Sneak-right-click the spawner to pick it up.
Carry it home and place it in a dark, enclosed room with a kill spot.

goals.text: Grow Natura Nether trees and berries
goals.hint: Use soul-sand sieving recipes to obtain Nether saplings and berries.
goals.why: The pack disables natural Natura tree generation; its recipe and sieve routes keep these materials obtainable.
steps: Collect soul sand in the Nether.
Use JEI to select the soul-sand sieving recipe and mesh for the sapling or berry you want.
Plant the result on its required soil with enough clear space, then harvest and replant.

goals.hint: A set of Ghostwood tools from the Nether.
A set of Bloodwood tools from the Nether.
A set of Darkwood tools from the Nether.
A set of Fusewood tools from the Nether.
Imp leather makes light armor.

goals.text: Craft and power a generator of some kind
goals.hint: Simple Generators burn fuel, food or lava for power. They charge machines next to them.
goals.why: Most tech machines run on Forge Energy (FE/RF). A generator is the start of every tech path.
steps: Craft a Furnace Generator (recipe below) or any other generator.
Put coal or charcoal in it.
Place a machine next to it, or connect it with conduits or cables.

goals.hint: Iron, a stick and an iron nugget make the tool that carves Ender Pearls.
Use the Glass Cutter on an Ender Pearl for an Ender Shard.
An Ender Shard and redstone make the crystal of every Extra Utilities machine.
Iron, redstone, a Resonating Redstone Crystal and a chest.
A redstone torch and planks make a Redstone Gear.
A Resonator powers up items placed on it.

goals.text: Make Burnt Stone in the Resonator
goals.hint: Smooth Stone on the Resonator becomes Burnt Stone.
Fuel a Survival or Furnace Generator to produce FE for machines.
goals.why: Extra Utilities generators produce machine energy. Grid Power (GP), used by mills and some utility blocks, is a separate system.
steps: Craft a Survival or Furnace Generator.
Insert a fuel accepted by its recipes and connect an FE cable or adjacent compatible machine.
Confirm energy reaches the machine; GP mills do not replace this FE supply.

goals.hint: Iron, a Machine Block, redstone and a blast furnace. The base of most special generators.
A mill you turn by hand.
A mill that turns with water.
Food in, power out.
TNT in, power out.
A furnace generator boosted with amethyst and blaze powder.
Slime makes a generator that burns slime.
An enchanting table turns enchanted items into power.
Gilded Obsidian uses a Nuggeto of Experience and obsidian.
Ender Pearls, Eye of Ender and Gilded Obsidian make an ender-powered generator.
A sickle harvests crops and leaves in an area.
Iron, pistons and a Machine Block grind ores.
Resonate a pressure plate into an Upgrade Base.
An Upgrade Base, gold and a redstone block make a Speed Upgrade.
A drum stores fluid.
A bigger drum stores more fluid.
Burnt Stone, a redstone block and a crystal make a wireless battery.

goals.text: Build Solar Panels from Solar Flux
goals.hint: Panels make power in daylight; neighboring panels share it.
goals.why: Free power during the day with no fuel. Higher tiers produce much more, and neighbouring panels share power.
steps: Craft solar panels (recipe below).
Place them under open sky, touching each other.

Run a line from a generator past your machines; it connects to each one.
Later add item and fluid conduits into the same blocks.

Point its output into a connected duct route ending at the destination inventory.
Use the duct controls to check its direction, then send a few test items.

Place it on top of a chest where items fall.

goals.text: Power a Shifter and move items through connected pipes
goals.hint: Use a redstone signal to run a Shifter; a held redstone torch changes its mode.
goals.why: Your first automated item line: items move from one chest to another by themselves.
steps: Place a Shifter between the source inventory and a Charset Pipe, facing into the pipe.
Connect the pipe to destination storage.
Use a held redstone torch on the Shifter to cycle Auto, Extract and Shift modes; use a stick or Charset Wrench to rotate toward a connected pipe.
Apply a redstone signal and confirm items move from source to destination.

goals.text: Use a Shifter to transfer fluid through a Charset Pipe
goals.hint: Place a tank behind the shifter instead of a chest.
goals.why: Move water or lava between tanks without buckets.
steps: Put a tank behind the shifter instead of a chest.
End the pipe at another tank and power the shifter.

goals.text: Set and clear an item or fluid filter on a Shifter
goals.hint: Click a side with an item to filter; click with an empty hand to clear.
goals.why: Only move the items you want, so one pipe line can sort.
steps: Use a sample item on a non-output face of the Shifter to set a matching filter.
For fluids, use a filled bucket or compatible fluid container as the sample.
Right-click that face with an empty hand to clear its filter.
Check the Shifter status and run a small transfer to confirm the filter.

goals.text: Craft a Charset Tape Drive and Audio Cable
goals.hint: Tapes are made from ingots, reels and smooth stone slabs (JEI).
goals.why: Charset audio records and plays back note-block music.
steps: Craft a tape drive, a tape and audio cable (recipes below).

obtain.sf3extras:charset_audio_tape: Crafting table: three iron or gold ingots (or gems) on top, a Tape Reel left and right in the middle, three smooth stone slabs at the bottom. The reels must have tape on them.

goals.text: Record a short note-block melody onto a Charset Audio Tape
goals.hint: Connect note blocks to the drive with audio cable and choose record.
goals.why: Save your music to play again anywhere.
steps: Connect your note blocks to the drive with audio cable.
Insert a tape and press Record.
Play the melody on the note blocks, then press Stop.

obtain.sf3extras:charset_audio_tape: Crafting table: three iron or gold ingots (or gems) on top, a Tape Reel left and right in the middle, three smooth stone slabs at the bottom. The reels must have tape on them.

goals.hint: Right-click the drive with an empty hand and press Play.
goals.why: Hear what you recorded.
steps: Rewind the tape in the drive.
Right-click the drive with an empty hand and press Play.

goals.text: Place a SuperCircuitMaker component on a circuit board
goals.hint: Place components directly onto the Circuit board in the world.
goals.why: Build complex redstone circuits inside a single block, on a 7x7 board with four layers.
goals.tip: There is no component-picker GUI in this port; build on the board itself.
steps: Place a Circuit board with its top accessible.
Hold a component item and right-click the desired cell on the board.
Use an empty hand to inspect or activate the aimed component.
Use a Squeegee to remove a component and recover its item.

goals.text: Build a powered circuit that controls a lamp
goals.hint: Route a signal across the board to its edge.
goals.why: Your tiny circuit drives real redstone outside the board.
steps: Wire an input edge of the board to an output edge.
Power the input side; put a lamp next to the output side.

goals.text: Set a component's value or delay with the screwdriver
goals.hint: The screwdriver changes component settings.
goals.why: Timers, counters and repeaters need settings.
steps: Aim at a Constant, Timer or Delay on the board and right-click with the Screwdriver to increase its setting.
Sneak-right-click to decrease the setting.
Hold a stick in your offhand when you want to rotate one of those components instead.
Sneak-use the Screwdriver on an empty cell to change the editing layer.

goals.text: Record and place a paid circuit blueprint
goals.hint: Blueprints copy a design onto an empty board.
goals.why: Copy a working design to new boards instead of rebuilding it.
goals.tip: Copying consumes components. An incomplete bill of materials does not build a partial circuit.
steps: Use a Blueprint or Redprint on a completed Circuit board to record its design.
Carry all components needed for the copy and place an empty board.
Sneak-use the recorded design on the empty board to build it.
Check the copy with a Multimeter and a test signal.

The cable metal of Refined Storage.

Craft a Raw Improved Processor with gold and smelt it.

Silicon, enriched iron, glass and redstone.

goals.text: Create a Refined Storage system to store your things
goals.hint: Controller + cables + disk drive + storage disks make one searchable network.
goals.why: All your items in one searchable terminal. It also feeds autocrafting later.
steps: Craft a controller, cables, a disk drive, a grid and storage disks.
Power the controller and connect everything with cables.
Put disks in the drive and open the grid.

goals.hint: A Grid shows everything in your network.
A 1k Storage Part in a Storage Housing makes a disk.
A bigger disk for the Disk Drive.
A bigger disk for the Disk Drive.
The largest normal disk.
A disk for fluids.

An Exporter pushes items from the network into an inventory.
An Interface does import and export in one block.

A Destructor breaks blocks into the network.
Speed up importers and exporters.
Move whole stacks with exporters and importers.

goals.text: Craft a Silk Touch Upgrade (Refined Storage)
goals.hint: Destructors with Silk Touch.
A monitor shows a stored item.
Outputs a redstone signal based on network contents.
Move items between disks and the network.
A Grid with a crafting table.
Glass, redstone and enriched iron. Programs an Autocrafter.

goals.text: Autocraft with a Refined Storage Autocrafter
goals.hint: Encode patterns in the Pattern Grid and put them in an Autocrafter.
goals.why: Ask for 64 of anything and the network crafts it from stored ingredients.
goals.tip: Ordinary crafting patterns are handled by the Autocrafter itself. Only processing patterns need an external machine.
steps: Connect an Autocrafter to the powered Refined Storage network.
Encode a crafting pattern in the Pattern Grid and insert it into the Autocrafter.
Put the required ingredients in network storage and request the result from a crafting-capable grid.
For processing patterns, face the Autocrafter toward the external machine and return its outputs to the network.

goals.hint: Lets importers and exporters trigger autocrafting.
Shows every Autocrafter in one block.
Watches all current crafting tasks.
A Relay gives a part of the network its own power control.
A transmitter that connects wireless devices to the network.
A Grid you carry in your pocket.
A portable Grid with its own disk slot.
Bind a Network Card to a Network Transmitter and carry it to a Receiver.
Manages who may use your network.
Sends a network over a distance.
Receives a network from a Network Transmitter.
Place two Item Translocators in the same one-block gap between inventories.
goals.why: Very fast item transfer between two inventories that touch.
goals.tip: Basic transfer does not require a redstone signal; redstone control is an upgrade behavior.
steps: Leave one air block between the inventories and place an Item Translocator on each inward-facing surface.
Toggle the source attachment to eject and the destination attachment to insert using their center controls.
Send a small test stack and confirm the direction.
Add the relevant upgrades only if you need faster transfer, filtering or redstone control.

goals.hint: A translocator for fluids.

goals.text: Link an Ender Pouch to an Ender Chest
goals.hint: Chests and pouches with the same three-wool color code share one inventory.
goals.why: Reach the same inventory from anywhere in the world, even other dimensions.
goals.tip: Public matching frequencies share contents. Check the chest's ownership controls before storing valuables.
steps: Place an EnderStorage chest and set its three-part color code with dyes.
Sneak-right-click that chest with an Ender Pouch to copy its frequency.
Open the pouch and verify a test item appears in both inventories.

goals.hint: A tank that links to others with the same colours.
Stores billions of one item. Needs four Obsidian Chests and an Ender IO Machine Chassis.
goals.why: One block holds billions of a single item: perfect for cobblestone, dirt or ores from automation.
steps: Make four Obsidian Chests and an Ender IO Machine Chassis.
Craft the Quantum DSU (recipe below).
Pipe items into it from any side.

goals.text: Convert storage safely between a DSU and a Vast Storage Unit
goals.hint: Empty it first: a DSU alone in the center of a crafting grid makes a VSU and back.
goals.why: The VSU works with Simple Labels to show its contents on a label.
steps: Empty the DSU first: converting deletes the stored items.
Put it alone in the center of the crafting grid.

goals.text: Fill a Quantum DSU with a renewable resource
goals.hint: Pipe a renewable resource into a DSU until it is full.
goals.why: An optional long-term stockpiling challenge for a renewable-material factory.
goals.tip: This is a very large endgame quantity challenge, not a prerequisite for ordinary storage.
steps: Connect a renewable material source to a DSU with enough transport capacity.
Keep the source and storage loaded while playing.
Watch the stored count and add a safe overflow or shutoff plan.
Tick this stretch goal once the DSU reaches its capacity.

goals.text: Use a Scannable Scanner to locate ores
goals.hint: Put a common or rare ores module in the scanner and right-click to see ores through walls.
goals.why: Find ore veins through walls instead of digging blindly.
steps: Craft the scanner and an ore module.
Charge the scanner with power.
Put the module in and right-click: ores glow through the stone.

goals.hint: Dye, clay, glowstone and gold make a blank module.
A blank module and an ender pearl add range.
A blank module and a lead scan for mobs.
A blank module and a water bucket scan for fluids.
A blank module and a chest scan for chests.

goals.text: Automate a Sieve with a Mechanical Sieve
goals.hint: The mechanical sieve sifts with power; send its output into storage.
goals.why: Sifting without clicking: a hopper feeds gravel in and the drops come out.
steps: Craft the mechanical sieve and power it.
Insert a mesh.
Feed gravel with a hopper and pull output into storage.

goals.hint: A powered hammer that turns incoming cobblestone into gravel on its own.
Smith a Diamond Mesh with Netherite for the best mesh.
The last hammer; it breaks everything at once.

goals.text: Grow Warped Nylium with Warped Nylium Spores
goals.hint: Spores from Crushed Netherrack grow nylium for warped fungus and trees.

goals.text: Grow Crimson Nylium with Crimson Nylium Spores
goals.hint: Spores from Crushed Netherrack grow crimson nylium for crimson fungus.
An Eye of Ender, sugar, eggs and Crushed End Stone make the End Cake.
Hit logs with a hammer to get Wood Chippings. They go into baits and the Sponge recipe.
Nine Flint make a Compressed Flint block, used in better compressed hammers.
The Heavy Sieve sifts compressed blocks in one go. Needs a log and a stick.
A Compressed Crook harvests a bigger area of leaves.
Baits attract animals. Craft a Cow Bait from Wheat and place it where you want cows.
Hit Cobblestone, Gravel or Sand with it to knock out dusts and ore bits.
Redstone, Glowstone Dust and a Stick make a zapper for bats.
A Diamond, a Crafting Table and a Stick make a tool for smashing ore blocks.
Powered hammer that grinds Cobblestone into Gravel for you.
Powered Sieve. Feed it from a chest with a Hopper.
The Auto Hammer for compressed blocks.

goals.text: Automate a resource with an Auto Heavy Sieve
goals.hint: Heavy sieves sift compressed blocks; the auto version runs on power.
goals.why: Heavy sieves sift compressed blocks: nine times the drops per sift.
steps: Craft and power the auto heavy sieve; insert a mesh.
Feed it compressed gravel (or sand, dust).

goals.text: Use an Auto Compressor to pack a renewable material into compressed blocks
goals.hint: It packs 9 items into one compressed block automatically.
goals.why: Packs nine items into one compressed block: feeds heavy sieves and saves storage.
steps: Craft and power the auto compressor.
Feed it cobblestone, gravel or sand from a generator line.

goals.hint: A cheaper Auto Compressor that compresses only items you keep in stock.
Arrange the JEI ingredients on an Infusion Altar and its pedestals, then activate it with redstone.
goals.why: Iron as a crop: an endless iron farm that needs no mining.
steps: Craft the seed base, required essence tier and iron ingredients shown in JEI.
Place the seed base on the Infusion Altar and the other ingredients on its eight pedestals.
Activate the altar with a redstone signal, such as a nearby button.
Plant the finished seed on compatible farmland and craft iron from the harvested essence.

goals.hint: Copper Ingots and Tertium Essence make Copper Seeds.
Redstone and Tertium Essence make Redstone Seeds.
Obsidian and Tertium Essence make Obsidian Seeds.
Lead Ingots and Tertium Essence make Lead Seeds.
Silver and Tertium Essence make Silver Seeds.
An Infusion Crystal and Tertium Essence make Imperium Essence, the fourth tier.
Gold Ingots and Imperium Essence make Gold Seeds.
Lapis Lazuli and Imperium Essence make Lapis Seeds.

goals.text: Use Growth Crystals or Growth Accelerators to speed up crops
goals.hint: Place a growth crystal near crops, or growth accelerators under the farmland.
goals.why: Resource crops grow slowly; accelerators make them grow much faster.
steps: Craft growth accelerators (or a growth crystal).
Stack accelerators under the farmland (more in a column = faster), or place the crystal near the crops.

goals.hint: Soulstone cobble smelts into Soulstone. It is the base of the awakening machines.
Smelt smooth Soulstone to get Soul Dust.
A Prosperity Ingot and Soulium Dust make a Soulium Ingot.

goals.text: Craft a Soulium Dagger and collect souls from mobs
goals.hint: Kill mobs with it to fill soul jars for mob seeds.
goals.why: Mob seeds grow bones, string, gunpowder, ender pearls and blaze rods without a mob farm.
steps: Craft the soulium dagger and soul jars.
Kill the mob type with the dagger while carrying jars until a jar is full.
Use the full jar in the mob seed recipe.

Store the souls of mobs.

goals.text: Make Plastic for Industrial Foregoing machines
goals.hint: Latex from a Fluid Extractor on trees becomes dry rubber, then plastic.
goals.why: Plastic builds Industrial Foregoing machines (plant gatherer, mob crusher ...).
steps: Place a Tree Fluid Extractor facing a supported log to produce latex.
Pipe latex and water into a powered Latex Processing Unit.
Collect Tiny Dry Rubber and craft nine into Dry Rubber.
Smelt Dry Rubber into Plastic, then use it for Industrial Foregoing machines.

goals.text: Upgrade your mob farm to kill monsters automatically
goals.hint: Spikes or a Mob Masher saw kill mobs; an Absorption Hopper collects drops and XP.
goals.why: An automatic farm keeps giving drops and XP while you do other things.
steps: Place spikes or a saw at the kill spot.
Place an absorption hopper to collect drops and XP.

goals.hint: Obsidian and iron let you take XP from a tank.
A bigger tank.
A conveyor that moves mobs.

Wool and a wither skeleton skull quiet the Wither's sound.
A block that spawns mobs from a captured sample.
A swab to take a sample from a mob.

goals.text: Stop mob spawns around your base with a Mega Torch
goals.hint: Place a Mega Torch to suppress ordinary hostile spawning in its configured range.
goals.why: Reduces darkness-based hostile spawns around your builds.
goals.tip: It does not remove existing monsters or guarantee protection from spawners, raids or special modded spawning.
steps: Craft and place the Mega Torch near the area you want protected.
Check the mod's range display or settings and cover any gaps.
Keep entrances secure and handle any mobs already present.

goals.hint: Obsidian, glass and glowstone make a bigger anti-spawn lamp.
Gold, glass and glowstone dust make a lantern that also blocks some spawns.
Ice and an ender pearl make a Frozen Pearl, another Torchmaster utility.
Design modular carts in the Cart Assembler.
goals.why: Steve's Carts are modular minecarts that mine tunnels, build rails, farm and chop trees.
steps: Craft the Cart Assembler.
Put a hull, an engine and tool modules in.
Assemble the cart and put it on rails.

Moves cargo between carts and chests.
Moves fluids between carts and tanks.

goals.text: Craft automatically with an RFTools Crafter
goals.hint: Crafters run crafting recipes with power.
goals.why: Crafts components by itself from ingredients fed in by pipes.
steps: Craft and power the crafter.
Set a recipe in its grid.
Feed ingredients in and pull results out.

goals.hint: A second crafter on top of the first.

goals.text: Craft an RFTools Crafter Mk III

goals.text: Show live information on an RFTools Screen
goals.hint: Screens display power, inventories and more.
goals.why: See your power, storage and machine status at a glance.
steps: Craft a screen and a screen controller and place them near each other.
Add modules (energy, inventory, clock) to the screen.

goals.why: Storage modules you can carry, plus a searchable interface.

Insert the module and store items.

Buttons, redstone and iron: dump your inventory into storage.

goals.text: Quarry or copy an area with the RFTools Builder
goals.hint: Insert a shape card into the builder.
goals.why: Quarry huge areas or copy builds automatically.
steps: Craft the Builder and the correct card for your task: a quarry card for mining, or a shape card for building.
Configure the area using the card's selection controls and preview the bounds.
Connect FE and suitable inventory space for collected blocks or building materials.
Start with a small expendable area and verify the operation before selecting a large build.

goals.hint: A Nether Star upgrades the Quarry Card with Silk Touch.
A pump card collects fluid.
An Infused Diamond, an Ender Pearl and a Machine Frame.
Combines shapes into complex ones.
Shows a hologram of a scan.
Gold, a torch, redstone and obsidian.
Moves blocks along a rail.
A chamber that copies a pattern for a Builder.
Computers run Lua programs; type "help" to start.
goals.why: Computers run Lua programs that can control redstone, monitors and machines.
steps: Place a Computer and right-click its terminal.
Enter edit startup.lua and write a small Lua program, such as print("Hello, Otto!").
Save and exit the editor, then run startup.lua.
Reboot the computer and verify the startup program runs.

goals.hint: Gold, redstone and glass make a computer with colour.

A printer prints text on paper.
Stone and an ender pearl send messages without wires.
Stone, a note block and redstone play sound.
Stone, a golden apple and glass make a computer you carry.

goals.text: Program a Turtle to mine for you
goals.hint: Craft a turtle with a pickaxe, add fuel and run "excavate 8".
goals.why: A little robot that digs a whole quarry while you do other things.
steps: Place a Mining Turtle facing a small test area and put furnace fuel in its selected slot.
At its terminal, run refuel all and check that it has fuel.
Run excavate 3 for a small first quarry; leave space and storage for the mined blocks.
Scale up only after confirming fuel, inventory space and the return path.

goals.hint: A better turtle with colour and more health.
The tiny part that every OC2 board uses.

A transistor, quartz, redstone and a diamond make a RISC-V CPU.
Copper, a transistor and a board make small memory.
Iron, lapis, a transistor and a board make storage.
Buttons and a bus interface let you type.
Assemble a computer with a CPU, memory and a hard drive.
goals.why: A full Linux computer in Minecraft for advanced automation.
goals.tip: A blank disk does not contain an operating system. Use the installed OpenComputers II manual for its current boot-disk and terminal setup.
steps: Craft a Computer, CPU, memory, power supply and a disk containing an operating system.
Install the parts and disk in the computer, then supply energy.
Connect a terminal or the supported display and keyboard devices described in the mod manual.
Boot the machine and confirm the operating-system prompt responds.

goals.hint: A hub connects several devices together.
A redstone interface reads and writes signals.
A robot is a computer that moves and works.
Visual programs that control machines and items.
goals.why: Program machines and item movement with a visual editor, no code needed.
steps: Craft a Processor, Programmer and Program Card, plus the CPU and memory hardware required by your program.
Supply the Processor with FE and install its supported hardware.
In the Programmer, create a small event-driven program and connect its operation flow, then save it to the Program Card.
Insert the card into the Processor, trigger the event and inspect its log or status output.
Add inventory access and machine-control operations after the simple program works.

goals.hint: Redstone, quartz, paper and a Machine Frame: the place where programs are written.

A Card Base, paper and redstone give a processor memory.

A crafting table, chest and Machine Frame.
A Card Base, crafting table and Machine Frame make an auto-crafting station.

goals.text: Infuse a machine to 100% with the Machine Infuser
goals.hint: Infused machines use less power.
goals.why: Infused RFTools machines use less power and work better.
steps: Craft the Machine Infuser and power it.
Put an RFTools machine and dimensional shards in.

goals.hint: Long Fall Boots stop all fall damage.
goals.why: Long Fall Boots protect against ordinary fall damage while equipped.
goals.tip: They do not protect you from lava, the void or every modded damage source.
steps: Craft the boots and equip them in the feet slot.
Confirm they remain equipped before working at height.

goals.text: Store experience in an XP Ring
goals.hint: Carry an XP Ring to absorb nearby experience orbs; use it to release the stored XP.
goals.why: Store your XP safely and take it back when you need to enchant or repair.
goals.tip: The ring stores points from nearby orbs, not levels withdrawn from your current XP bar.
steps: Craft an XP Ring and keep it in your inventory.
Collect experience near it and inspect its Internal Experience tooltip.
Right-click while holding it to transfer all stored experience to your player.

goals.text: Upgrade to a Diamond Backpack with a Magnet Upgrade
goals.hint: Upgrade the backpack tier in a crafting grid; the magnet pulls items to you.
goals.why: Far more space, and dropped items fly to you.
steps: Upgrade the backpack tier by tier in the crafting grid (iron, gold, diamond).
Craft a magnet upgrade and put it in an upgrade slot.

goals.text: Shape blocks with Extra Bit Manipulation sculpting tools
goals.hint: Sculpting tools add or remove Chisels & Bits bits in spheres and cubes.
goals.why: Sculpt big curved shapes out of Chisels & Bits blocks quickly.
steps: Craft a sculpting tool (recipe below).
Use it on blocks to add or remove bits in spheres and cubes.

goals.text: Store Chisels & Bits bits in a Bit Drawer
goals.hint: Drawers & Bits stores bits by block type.
goals.why: Keeps your bit collection organized by block type.
steps: Craft the bit drawer.
Insert bits from your inventory.

goals.text: Pick up a mob with a Capturing Wand
goals.hint: Capture a mob in the wand and release it somewhere else.
goals.why: Move animals and mobs to your farms without leads.
steps: Craft the wand.
Right-click a mob to capture it.
Right-click a block to release it.

goals.text: Collect nearby drops with a Random Things Item Collector
goals.hint: Attach the basic Item Collector to storage to collect drops within three blocks.
goals.why: Gathers drops around farms automatically.
steps: Craft the Item Collector and attach it to a compatible inventory.
Place a dropped test item within three blocks and confirm it enters the inventory.
Keep enough destination space; use the Advanced Collector for adjustable range and filtering.

goals.hint: A collector with more range.
A redstone-controlled block breaker.
Stops mobs from spawning nearby.
Points to the nearest biome.
Floo Powder travels between Floo Fireplaces.
A bucket that never spills.

goals.text: Redirect a dropped item into connected storage
goals.hint: Item redirectors steer items moving across them.
goals.why: Steer item streams into the right chest.
goals.tip: The Redirector steers item entities; it is not an item pipe that inserts directly into a chest.
steps: Place an Item Redirector in the path of moving dropped items.
Use a stick on its output side to set the outgoing direction; sneak-use the stick to set the incoming side.
Feed a moving test item from that input direction and verify its new path.
Finish the path at a hopper or Item Collector attached to storage.

goals.text: Use the Voxel Projector to display an item
goals.hint: The projector shows a large hologram of an item.
goals.why: Big holograms for decoration and shops.
steps: Place the Voxel Projector and use an ordinary item on it to choose that item as the projection.
Use a stick for rotation, redstone for rotation speed, and quartz for scale.
Sneak while using those controls to decrease their values.
Use glowstone dust to toggle lighting, or an ender pearl to toggle randomization.

goals.text: Project a prepared VOX model with the Voxel Projector
goals.hint: Load a prepared .vox model through the projector's server command.
goals.why: Show your own 3D models as holograms.
goals.tip: This goal requires a prepared server-side file and command access. The ordinary item-projection goal needs neither.
steps: Have the server owner place the approved .vox file in config/randomthings/models/.
Stand at the projector and use /sf3voxel <model> with the file's model name.
Check the loaded projection, then adjust rotation, speed and scale with its item controls.

goals.text: Open a Chance Cube - if you dare
goals.hint: Breaking a chance cube does something random, good or very bad.
goals.why: A gamble: diamonds, mobs, explosions or something silly.
steps: Craft or find a chance cube.
Break it far away from your base.

goals.text: Assemble a Precision Mechanism with Create machinery
goals.hint: Repeat the JEI deployer sequence on a gold sheet; collect the finished mechanism.
goals.why: Precision mechanisms are needed for Create's advanced machines, arms and train parts.
goals.tip: This recipe is a deployer sequence. A press is used to make the starting gold sheet, not as a step in the sequence.
steps: Open Precision Mechanism in JEI and select Sequenced Assembly.
Feed a gold sheet through deployers applying the small cogwheel, large cogwheel and iron nugget in the shown order.
Repeat the sequence the number of times JEI specifies, using a loop or manual passes.
Collect the result and handle byproducts; assembly has a chance to produce a different item.

goals.hint: A robot arm that moves items between blocks.
A brass casing and a Precision Mechanism set an exact speed.
A big storage block made of iron and barrels.
Cardboard, iron and redstone make a packager.
A transmitter and a vault link a stock network.
A stock link, glass and gold make the ticker.
A vault, slime and andesite alloy make a frog that delivers packages.
A stock link, iron and redstone request items.
A stock link and a Precision Mechanism watch a recipe.
Slabs and smooth stone store and read schematics.
Prints a schematic by firing blocks.
A backpack of air for breathing and tools.
Copper and glass for underwater breathing.
A longer reach for interacting.
A cannon that fires potatoes and other items.
A wand that mirrors your building.

goals.text: Keep a useful Create production line supplied and collect its output automatically
goals.hint: Feed inputs with funnels and belts and send output to storage.
goals.why: A hands-off production line keeps making what you need.
steps: Supply inputs with funnels, chutes or mechanical arms.
Send outputs into storage.

goals.text: Fly a propeller airship you can steer
goals.hint: Propeller Bearings push a contraption; a Steering Wheel and Throttle Lever control it.
goals.why: Propellers give thrust in any direction, so you fly where you want instead of drifting. An airship is a flying base with storage, machines and a crew.
goals.tip: Aviator's Goggles (leather and Engineer's Goggles) show thrust and stress. Gyroscopic Propeller Bearings stay level and suit helicopters. Thrust weakens high up; an Altitude Sensor reads air pressure.
steps: Start from a hot air balloon (or Levitite later) that can already hold its own weight.
Craft Propeller Bearings (wooden slab, iron sheet, brass casing). Put sails or an Andesite Propeller on the front of each bearing: a propeller needs at least two sail blocks.
Give the bearings rotation, for example from a Portable Engine (it burns fuel like a furnace) on board.
Add a Steering Wheel and a Throttle Lever to control the rotation, then glue everything and assemble it.
Reverse thrust by reversing the rotation or with a wrench on the bearing.

goals.text: Run a renewable material through processing into storage without manual item transfers
goals.hint: Connect generator -> processing -> storage with pipes, ducts or a network.
goals.why: True automation: a material made, processed and stored without you.
steps: Choose a source (cobble generator), a processor (hammer, sieve) and storage.
Connect them with transport.

goals.text: Add an overflow plan so your resource factory can run safely
goals.hint: Send excess into a void (trash can, void upgrade) or stop the machine when storage is full.
goals.why: When storage is full a factory can stall or flood the ground with items.
goals.tip: Do not attach an unfiltered void to valuable mixed storage.
steps: Choose whether the system should stop when full or discard only a specific renewable excess.
Add filtered overflow storage and a void/trash destination at lower priority, or a storage-full signal that stops production.
Fill a test destination and verify the machine stops or routes only the intended excess.

goals.text: Drain a lake with a Ranged Pump
goals.hint: The pump removes fluid in a large area and stores it.
goals.why: Clears water for underwater builds, or collects lava as fuel.
goals.tip: Move the collected fluid out as the internal tank fills.
steps: Place the Ranged Pump above the fluid area you intend to clear.
Supply FE and connect an extraction pipe to an empty compatible tank.
Check the pump's configured range and let it drain; keep the work area loaded.

goals.text: Keep a remote factory running with a Chunk Loader
goals.hint: ChickenChunks loaders keep chunks loaded while you are away.
goals.why: Machines only run in loaded chunks; a loader keeps them running while you are away.
steps: Craft a chunk loader.
Place it at the factory.
Right-click it to set the radius.

goals.text: Link machines wirelessly with Flux Networks
goals.hint: Flux points and plugs send power anywhere on the same network.
goals.why: Send power across your whole base, or across dimensions, with no cables.
steps: Craft a flux controller, flux plugs and flux points.
Put plugs on generators and points on machines.
Open each one and put them all on the same network.

Greenhouse glass grows plants without sun.
Shock suppression protects from lightning.

goals.text: Craft a Lens of the Miner
goals.hint: A lens for the Reconstructor that mines ores for you.
Heavy Engineering blocks and steel build a press that makes plates and rods.
Molds shape the press output.
A multiblock that squeezes oil from seeds.
A multiblock that turns plants into ethanol.
A multiblock that refines oil into fuel.

Paper-based tools to survey the area for ore.

Obsidian, nether bricks, a Demonic Slate and a blaze rod at the Hellfire Forge.

goals.text: Enter the Twilight Forest and secure a safe arrival point
goals.hint: Ring a 2x2 water pool with flowers and throw in a diamond to open the portal.
goals.why: The Twilight Forest is a whole dimension of bosses that unlock each other in order, with unique loot (Naga scales, Lich scepters, fiery tools).
goals.tip: Use the Magic Map (twilight) to find the boss structures; each boss unlocks the next area.
steps: Dig a 2 x 2 pool one block deep and fill it with water.
Surround the entire pool with a ring of dirt or grass and plants, including the corners.
Throw a diamond into the water and stand clear of the lightning.
Enter, secure the arrival point and mark the return portal on your map.

diagram.title: Twilight portal
diagram.view: A 2x2 pool ringed by grass, with a flower on every ring block.
diagram.note: Any flower or tall grass works, on grass or dirt. Corners can stay empty. Two water buckets fill the pool.

obtain.minecraft:poppy: Pick flowers in grassy biomes, or use bone meal on grass to grow some. Any flower or tall grass works.
obtain.minecraft:grass_block: Mine grass with a Silk Touch tool, or place dirt next to grass in the light and wait for it to spread.
obtain.minecraft:water_bucket: Right-click any water with an empty bucket. A 2x2 pool refills itself.

goals.hint: Small hills of grass hide treasure and mobs. Follow the soft hills.
Kill a Twilight Deer for Raw Venison and cook it.
A hedge maze hides treasure at its center.
Feed the Quest Ram's missing wool colours for a reward.
A tall mushroom tower in the Mushroom Forest.
Break down items into their parts.
A map that fills in the whole biome.

goals.text: Collect Ironwood and Steeleaf in the Twilight Forest
goals.hint: Craft and smelt Raw Ironwood; find Steeleaf as Twilight dungeon loot.
goals.why: Twilight materials provide another equipment path and ingredients for the dimension's crafting recipes.
steps: Collect Liveroot and the other Raw Ironwood ingredients shown in JEI, then craft Raw Ironwood.
Smelt it into Ironwood Ingots.
Loot Twilight dungeon chests for Steeleaf; it is not harvested from a Steeleaf tree.

goals.hint: Ironwood tools are tough and repair themselves.
A set of Ironwood armor.
Steeleaf tools are fast and also repair themselves.
A set of Steeleaf armor.

goals.text: Defeat the Naga and obtain its progression reward
goals.hint: The Naga lives in a mossy stone courtyard. Its scales open the Lich Tower.
goals.why: Defeating the Naga and collecting its scales advances Twilight progression toward the Lich.
goals.tip: Pick up the boss drops yourself so the advancement can trigger. Check the Twilight advancement tree if an area remains protected.
steps: Find the Naga Courtyard (mossy stone walls).
Fight in the open: dodge its charges, hit its head.
Collect the Naga scales and trophy.

mobs.where: Lives in the Naga Courtyard, a mossy stone-walled arena in the Twilight Forest. A Magic Map shows where.

goals.hint: Naga scales make a strong chestplate.
Naga scales make leggings that speed you up.

goals.text: Defeat the Twilight Lich after completing Naga progression
goals.hint: Reflect the Lich's pearl projectiles to break its shields, then fight through its later phases.
goals.why: The Lich unlocks the Labyrinth, the Dark Forest and the Snowy Forest, and drops the Zombie/Lifedrain/Twilight scepters.
steps: Complete the Naga advancement and find a Lich Tower.
At the top, distinguish the real Lich from its invulnerable copies.
Hit incoming pearl projectiles back at the real Lich to break its shields; avoid the explosive fireballs.
Defeat its later phases and collect the scepter reward.

mobs.where: Waits at the top of the Lich Tower, a tall stone tower in the Twilight Forest. Defeat the Naga first or the tower stays sealed.

goals.hint: Fires bolts that teleport targets.
Steals life from targets.
Raises loyal zombies.
Gives you bonus protection.

goals.text: Bring a trophy from a defeated Twilight Forest boss back to your base
goals.hint: Every Twilight boss drops a trophy.
goals.why: A memento of the fight and a decoration that animates when powered.
steps: Pick up the trophy the boss drops.
Place it at home (it plays the boss sound when powered by redstone).

mobs.where: Lives in the Naga Courtyard, a mossy stone-walled arena in the Twilight Forest. A Magic Map shows where.

goals.text: Defeat the Minoshroom in the Labyrinth and eat its Meef Stroganoff
goals.hint: The labyrinth is under the swamp and opens after the Lich. The Minoshroom drops Meef Stroganoff, which lifts the Fire Swamp curse.
goals.why: Without eating Meef Stroganoff the Fire Swamp burns you. It opens the way to the Hydra.
steps: Find the Labyrinth under the swamp.
Find the Minoshroom and defeat it.
Eat the Meef Stroganoff it drops.

obtain.twilightforest:meef_stroganoff: Dropped by the Minoshroom in the Labyrinth.

mobs.where: Guards the deepest room of the Labyrinth, under the Swamp biome. Opens after the Lich; a Maze Map helps you find the way.

goals.hint: The Labyrinth minotaurs drop meat.
Cook raw meef.
A heavy axe found in the Labyrinth.
A diamond axe found in the Labyrinth.
Read the maze with a Maze Map.
See ores near you.
Counts nearby ores.
Pulls ores out of the ground.
A horn that crumbles blocks.
A fan that gives you a big hop.
A queen of moonworms to place light.

goals.text: Enter the Aether and secure your return route
goals.hint: Build a glowstone portal frame and pour water inside.
goals.why: The Aether is a sky dimension with Zanite, Gravitite and three dungeon bosses that drop powerful accessories.
steps: Collect 10 glowstone blocks (Nether) and build the frame below.
Pour a water bucket inside the frame.
Step in. Do not fall off the islands: bring blocks.

diagram.title: Aether portal
diagram.view: Side view (stand it upright)
diagram.note: Corners optional. Pour water into the middle.

obtain.minecraft:glowstone: Glowstone hangs from Nether ceilings. Mining it drops dust; 4 dust make a block. Sifting dust also gives glowstone dust.

goals.text: Chop Skyroot and make Skyroot tools
goals.hint: Aether wood gives double drops with skyroot tools.
goals.why: Skyroot tools mine Holystone, the first Aether stone, and double drops of Aether logs.
steps: Chop skyroot trees on the islands.
Craft skyroot planks and skyroot tools (recipe below).
Use the skyroot pickaxe to mine Holystone for holystone tools.

goals.hint: Skyroot planks make Skyroot Sticks, the handles of all Aether tools.
Skyroot planks and a stick make a basic sword.
A bucket of Skyroot that carries water and milk.

Ambrosium Ore gives Shards that heal and light torches.
An Ambrosium Shard and a stick make a long-lasting torch.
A cold Aercloud makes a one-use Cold Parachute for falls.

goals.text: Read the Aether Book of Lore
goals.hint: The Book of Lore explains every Aether item you put in it.
goals.why: Explains every Aether item and block you put into it.
steps: Craft the Book of Lore.
Right-click it and put an item in the slot.

goals.hint: Holystone and an Ambrosium Torch hatch Moa eggs.
Holystone, Icestone and Skyroot make a freezer that makes ice items.
Blue Moas lay eggs that hatch into a rideable Moa.

goals.text: Collect Zanite and improve your Aether equipment
goals.hint: Zanite tools get stronger as they wear down.
goals.why: Zanite is the Aether iron: tools that get stronger as they wear down, and needed for gravitite.
steps: Mine zanite ore (purple gems in holystone) with a holystone pickaxe.
Craft zanite tools.

goals.hint: Zanite tools mine faster the more worn they get.
A solid mid-tier Zanite sword.
A mid-tier armor set made of Zanite Gemstones.
Rings are accessories worn in a Curios slot.
A pendant is another accessory.
Freeze an Iron Ring in the Freezer.
Gloves protect your hands and boost attack.
A Zanite Gemstone and a stick heal and grow plants.
The altar enchants items using ambrosium shards as fuel.
goals.why: The altar enchants gravitite and repairs Aether tools, fuelled by ambrosium shards.
steps: Craft the altar from holystone and zanite.
Fuel it with ambrosium shards and put an item in.

goals.text: Use the Altar to obtain Enchanted Gravitite
goals.hint: Enchant gravitite ore in the altar.
goals.why: Enchanted gravitite makes the strongest Aether tools and armor.
goals.tip: Gravitite ore blocks rise when disturbed; keep track of them while mining.
steps: Mine Gravitite Ore with a Zanite Pickaxe or better.
Put the ore in an Aether Altar fueled with Ambrosium Shards.
Collect Enchanted Gravitite and use it in the recipes below.

goals.hint: Enchanted Gravitite makes an excellent pickaxe.
A gravitite sword.
Gravitite armor gives top defense.
Gravitite gloves.
Bronze dungeons are hidden inside Aether islands.
goals.why: Dungeons hold the bosses and keys to treasure chests.
steps: Find a bronze dungeon (holystone rooms inside big islands).

goals.hint: A Slider drops the Bronze Dungeon Key.
A Valkyrie Queen drops the Silver Dungeon Key.
A Sun Spirit drops the Gold Dungeon Key.
A medal for defeating a dungeon boss.
A dungeon sword that sets targets on fire.
A dungeon sword with the Holy touch against undead.
A dungeon sword that calls lightning.
A dungeon blade that heals you when it hits.
A dungeon bow that fires flaming arrows.
A Valkyrie lance, found in the dungeons.

goals.text: Defeat the Slider in the Bronze Dungeon
goals.hint: Hit the Slider with a pickaxe; dodge its charges.
goals.why: Drops the bronze key for the treasure room (gloves, the Hammer of Notch).
steps: Use a pickaxe: swords barely hurt it.
Dodge its sliding charges and hit it when it stops.

mobs.where: Sits in the boss room of a Bronze Dungeon, hidden inside Aether islands. Only pickaxes hurt it.

goals.text: Defeat the Valkyrie Queen in a Silver Dungeon
goals.hint: Silver dungeons are large white temples on clouds.
goals.why: Drops the silver key: valkyrie lance, armor and more.
steps: Defeat 10 valkyries in the dungeon to earn medals.
Give the medals to the queen to start the fight.

mobs.where: Rules a Silver Dungeon, a white temple on the clouds. Defeat 10 Valkyries there to earn medals before she will fight.

goals.hint: Valkyrie armor from the Silver Dungeon.
Phoenix armor protects against fire.
Neptune armor helps underwater.
Sentry boots from the Bronze Dungeon.
A shield that pushes enemies back.

goals.text: Defeat the Sun Spirit in a Gold Dungeon
goals.hint: Find the Gold Dungeon and return the Sun Spirit's ice projectiles.
goals.why: The final Aether boss; its treasure includes phoenix armor and the vampire blade.
steps: Prepare equipment, food and fire protection, then enter a Gold Dungeon.
Start the fight through the Sun Spirit's dialogue.
Dodge fire attacks and strike the ice projectiles back at the boss.
Defeat it and use the reward key on its treasure.

mobs.where: Rules a Gold Dungeon inside the largest floating islands of the Aether.

goals.hint: A trinket that slowly heals you.
A shard that adds a heart when used.
A staff that makes a cloud platform.
A trinket that slows your fall.
A cloak that makes you invisible.

goals.text: Visit an Ancient City and escape the Warden
goals.hint: Ancient cities lie in the deep dark. Sneak and avoid sculk shriekers.
goals.why: Ancient cities hold enchanted books, echo shards (recovery compasses) and rare loot.
goals.tip: Sneaking helps but does not silence every action. Fighting the Warden is not required for this goal.
steps: Explore the Deep Dark for an Ancient City, bringing wool, food and a clear escape route.
Use wool paths and avoid activating sensors and shriekers; opening containers can make noise.
Loot carefully and retreat if warning levels rise or a Warden emerges.

goals.hint: An Echo Shard and an Ender Pearl make a Sculk Core.
Echo shards and a compass lead to your last death.

goals.text: Locate a Stronghold and travel to the End
goals.hint: Throw eyes of ender to find the stronghold, then fill the portal frame.
goals.why: The End holds the Ender Dragon, End cities, shulkers and elytra. Draconic Evolution starts here.
steps: Craft about 14 eyes of ender (ender pearl + blaze powder).
Throw one into the air and walk where it flies.
Dig down where it falls; find the portal room.
Fill the 12 frames with eyes and jump in.

diagram.title: End portal
diagram.view: Top view (already built in the stronghold)
diagram.note: Put an Eye of Ender in every frame that is missing one.

obtain.minecraft:end_portal_frame: Cannot be crafted or picked up: the frame is already built in the stronghold portal room. You only add Eyes of Ender.

goals.hint: Destroy the end crystals on top of the pillars first.
goals.why: Unlocks the End gateways (End cities), the dragon egg and dragon breath.
steps: Bring a bow, many arrows, blocks, slow falling or water.
Shoot the end crystals on the pillars.
Hit the dragon when it perches.

mobs.where: Lives on the main End island; reach it through the End portal in a stronghold. After the first fight, summon it again by placing 4 End Crystals around the exit portal.

goals.hint: Use empty bottles on the dragon's purple breath cloud.
goals.why: Needed for lingering potions and some mod recipes.
steps: During the dragon fight, use empty bottles on the purple breath cloud.

obtain.minecraft:dragon_breath: Use empty glass bottles on the purple breath clouds of the Ender Dragon.

mobs.where: Lives on the main End island; reach it through the End portal in a stronghold. After the first fight, summon it again by placing 4 End Crystals around the exit portal.

goals.text: Resurrect the Ender Dragon with End Crystals
goals.hint: Place four end crystals on the edges of the exit portal.
goals.why: Fight it again for more experience; the egg only drops once.
steps: Craft 4 end crystals.
Place one on each side of the exit portal.

goals.text: Travel to an End City and obtain Elytra
goals.hint: End cities are on the outer End islands; elytra hang inside their ships.
goals.why: Elytra let you glide; with fireworks you fly fast across the world.
steps: Throw an ender pearl into a small End gateway portal.
Search the outer islands for End cities with a ship.
Take the elytra from the item frame in the ship.

obtain.minecraft:elytra: Hangs in an item frame inside the ships of End cities.

goals.hint: End city shulkers drop shells for shulker boxes.
Chorus fruit grows in the End and teleports you.
Glass, an Eye of Ender and a ghast tear make end crystals.
Two shulker shells around a chest. Shulker boxes keep their contents when broken.
goals.why: Portable chests that keep items when picked up.
steps: Kill shulkers in End cities for shells.
Craft a shulker box: two shells around a chest.
Break it with items inside: they stay inside.

goals.text: Eat an End Cake to visit the End
goals.hint: Each slice of the End Cake teleports you to the End.
goals.why: A quick trip to the End once you have been there.
steps: Craft the End Cake and place it.
Eat a slice to teleport to the End.

goals.text: Hatch a Dragon Egg and train it
goals.hint: Dragon Mounts: the biome an egg hatches in decides the dragon type. Tame and saddle it.
goals.why: Your own rideable dragon. The biome it hatches in decides its type.
steps: Place the egg in the biome you want.
Right-click it and wait for it to hatch.
Feed it fish to tame it; saddle it to ride.

mobs.where: Hatch one from a Dragon Mounts egg: place the egg and right-click it; the biome it hatches in decides the dragon type. Wild dragons also roam many biomes.

goals.hint: Four soul sand in a T with three wither skeleton skulls on top. Fight it underground.
goals.why: The nether star is needed for a beacon, the Nether Star Generator and many endgame recipes.
steps: Kill wither skeletons in fortresses for 3 skulls.
Build the T of soul sand (deep underground or in the End).
Place the skulls last.
Fight with a strong sword, healing potions and milk (wither effect).

diagram.title: Summon the Wither
diagram.view: Side view
diagram.note: Soul soil works too. The last skull you place starts the fight.

obtain.minecraft:wither_skeleton_skull: Dropped (rarely) by wither skeletons in Nether fortresses. Looting helps.
obtain.minecraft:soul_sand: Found in Nether soul sand valleys and around fortresses. Soul soil works for the Wither too.
