goals.hint: A nether star, dragon's breath, black quartz and prismarine.
Gives you the power of flight.

goals.text: Pick up a Totem of Undying
goals.hint: Evokers drop totems that save you from death.
Drowned sometimes drop tridents.
Heart of the Sea and nautilus shells make a conduit.

goals.text: Build a Beacon on a pyramid
goals.hint: A nether star, glass and obsidian make a beacon; put it on a 3x3 (or bigger) metal pyramid.
goals.why: Speed and haste for your base. The Gaia Guardian ritual is started at a beacon.
steps: Craft a Beacon and build a solid 3 x 3 base of supported mineral blocks.
Place the Beacon centered on top and leave its upward beam path unobstructed.
Open it, choose an available effect and pay with an accepted ingot or gem.
Expand the complete pyramid layers later to unlock more effects and range.

diagram.title: Beacon base
diagram.view: A beacon on a 3x3 layer of metal blocks.
diagram.note: Gold, diamond, emerald or netherite blocks work too.

goals.hint: A Wither cage with damage and a way to collect nether stars.
goals.why: Endless nether stars for beacons, generators and endgame recipes.
steps: Build a cage the Wither cannot break.
Use automated damage (spikes, a mob masher) and a collector for the star.

goals.hint: Ancient debris is deep in the Nether. Smelt it into scrap; 4 scrap and 4 gold make an ingot.
goals.why: Netherite gear is the strongest vanilla gear and does not burn.
goals.tip: Templates are consumed. Beds explode in the Nether, so ordinary tunnel mining is the safer starting method.
steps: Mine Ancient Debris deep in the Nether, using a diamond pickaxe or better.
Smelt debris into Netherite Scrap, then craft four scrap with four gold ingots into a Netherite Ingot.
Obtain a Netherite Upgrade Smithing Template from a bastion; duplicate it before using your last one.
Combine the template, diamond equipment and ingot at a Smithing Table.

goals.hint: A smithing table, netherite ingot and diamond pickaxe.
A Netherite Ingot in a ring of chiseled stone bricks sets a compass target.
A full set of netherite armor.

goals.text: Craft a Speed Upgrade for chickens
goals.hint: Netherite, an Ender Eye and a diamond.
Craft the Beneath Teleporter (JEI) and use it. Bring torches: it is very dark.
goals.why: A dark SkyFactory underworld with its own resources.
steps: Craft the Beneath Teleporter (recipe below).
Use it; bring torches.

goals.hint: An Infusion Crystal and Imperium Essence make Supremium Essence, the fifth tier.
Use the Diamond Seed Infusion Altar recipe, then grow and harvest Diamond Essence.
goals.why: A renewable diamond supply once you can afford the seed and support its farm.
goals.tip: Check farmland and growth-device tooltips for their actual bonuses; higher-tier farmland is not a universal speed multiplier.
steps: Upgrade essence through its tiers using four essence and an Infusion Crystal in each recipe.
Use JEI to gather the Diamond Seed's exact seed base, essence and diamond ingredients.
Place the base on the Infusion Altar, arrange ingredients on the pedestals and supply a redstone signal.
Plant the seed on compatible farmland and use JEI to turn its harvested essence into diamonds.

goals.hint: Supremium Essence on farmland.
An Emerald and Supremium Essence make Emerald Seeds.
Imperium tools and armor are upgrades of the previous tier.
The Ender IO Farming Station or the Industrial Foregoing Plant Gatherer plants and harvests for you.
goals.why: Plants and harvests your farms with no clicking.
steps: Choose a Farming Station or an Industrial Foregoing Plant Gatherer for your crop type.
Supply FE and check the working area.
For a Farming Station, provide its required tools, seeds and capacitor. For Industrial Foregoing, add a Plant Sower if replanting is needed.
Route harvested items into storage while retaining enough seeds for replanting.

goals.hint: Soularium and quartz powder make a Soul Chain.
Soularium and fused quartz make a Soul Vial to capture mobs.
A Soul Chain, Soularium and quartz make a chassis for soul machines.
Soularium, a player head and an Ensouled Chassis.
A Zombie Head, Soularium, silicon and redstone are sliced together in the Slice'N'Splice.
Soularium, a Soul Vial and an Ensouled Chassis.
The Soul Binder turns a Vibrant Crystal into an Ender Crystal.
The Soul Binder turns a Vibrant Crystal into a Prescient Crystal.
Pulsating, Vibrant and Ender Crystal make a Weather Crystal.
An Ender Crystal and Dark Steel make a staff that teleports you.
Iron, an Ender Chest and a Pulsating Crystal pull in items nearby.
Iron, a Void Vial and a Pulsating Crystal collect XP orbs.
Soularium, a seed and Vibrant Alloy make a rod that stores experience.
An Experience Rod and Soularium store experience.
Soularium, a Broken Spawner, a chassis and a Vibrant Crystal.
A top-tier capacitor bank.
Dark Steel and fused quartz store huge amounts of fluid.
An obelisk that attracts mobs of a chosen kind.
An obelisk that stops mobs from spawning nearby.
An obelisk that controls the weather.

goals.text: Infuse Terrasteel on a Terrestrial Agglomeration Plate
goals.hint: Put manasteel, a mana diamond and a mana pearl on the plate and send it lots of mana.
goals.why: Terrasteel makes the Terra Blade, Terra Shatterer and starts the Gaia ritual.
goals.tip: The craft needs a large mana supply. Picking up ingredients early interrupts the process.
steps: Build the Livingrock/Lapis platform exactly as shown in the Lexica Botania and place the plate on top.
Link a mana supply to the plate with Sparks and store enough mana before starting.
Drop one Manasteel Ingot, one Mana Diamond and one Mana Pearl onto the plate.
Wait for the completed Terrasteel before collecting it.

goals.hint: A Terrasteel sword that fires beams.
A Terrasteel pickaxe that mines a wide area.
A Terrasteel axe that fells whole trees.
A set of Terrasteel armor with strong protection.
A Terrasteel tool that stores mana and can draw it from a bound pool.
A gun that fires mana bursts.
A throwable blade that returns to you.

goals.text: Craft a Rod of the Lands
goals.hint: A rod that places Dirt.

goals.text: Craft a Rod of the Skies
goals.hint: A rod that lifts you into the air.

goals.text: Craft a Rod of the Hells
goals.hint: A rod that sets targets alight.
A band that stores mana and charges your other items.
A ring that pulls dropped items toward you.

goals.text: Open a portal to Alfheim with an Elven Gateway Core
goals.hint: Livingwood frame, glimmering livingwood, Natura Pylons on mana pools, then activate with the wand.
goals.why: Trading with elves gives Elementium, Pixie Dust and Dragonstone.
steps: Build the portal frame from livingwood (see the Lexica "Alfheim" page).
Put two Natura pylons on mana pools next to the frame.
Use the wand on the core.

goals.hint: Throw a Manasteel Ingot into the Alfheim portal for an Elementium Ingot.
Throw a Mana Pearl into the Alfheim portal for Pixie Dust.
A flower that turns stone into ore using mana.
Throw a Mana Diamond into the Alfheim portal for a Dragonstone.
Throw Livingwood into the Alfheim portal for Dreamwood.
Throw Managlass into the Alfheim portal for Alfglass.
Dreamwood logs craft the twigs used in Elementium tools and rods.
Dreamwood and Elementium make a faster Spreader.
Elementium tools mine faster and hold mana better than Manasteel.
Elementium armor offers stronger protection.
Pixie Dust and Elementium make a catalyst that copies items with mana.
Pixie Dust, Elementium and a Mana Pylon make a pylon for the Gaia ritual.
Combine a Mana Spark and Pixie Dust to link Corporea blocks.
The Index finds any item in a Corporea network when you ask for it in chat.
A tinkerer adds augments to Sparks.
A glove that opens your Ender Chest.

goals.text: Craft a Ring of Far Reach
goals.hint: A ring that increases your block reach.
Yellorite ore generates underground in the Overworld.
goals.why: Yellorium is the fuel for Extreme Reactors.
steps: Find yellorite ore (yellow specks) underground.
Smelt it into yellorium ingots.

obtain.bigreactors:yellorium_ingot: Smelt yellorite ore (or raw yellorium), found underground in the Overworld.

goals.hint: Blast coal or charcoal in a furnace to get Graphite for reactor parts.
Iron, graphite and sand make a Reactor Casing.
Glass and a casing make reactor glass.
Iron, graphite, glass and yellorium ingots.
A casing, graphite, a piston, iron and redstone.
A casing, comparator, yellorium, diamond and redstone.
A casing and a redstone block output power from a passive reactor.

goals.text: Create a passively cooled reactor from Extreme Reactors
goals.hint: Casing, a controller, yellorium fuel rods and a power port.
goals.why: A reactor makes huge power from a little fuel.
steps: Build the hollow casing shown below, leaving room for fuel-rod columns.
Cap each fuel column with a Reactor Control Rod in the roof.
Include the Controller, solid Access Port and passive FE Power Tap; use matching reactor tiers.
Check the Controller for assembly errors, insert fuel through the Access Port and connect energy storage.
Start at low demand, monitor fuel and heat, and adjust control rods before scaling up.

diagram.title: Smallest reactor (3x3x3)
diagram.view: One fuel rod in the middle, a control rod on top of it, the rest casing with the ports on the sides.
diagram.note: Bigger reactors: more fuel rod columns, each with a control rod on top. Reactor glass can replace casing on the faces.

goals.text: Assemble an Advanced Generators gas turbine
goals.hint: Connect a controller to its modules; right-click the controller for status.
goals.why: Advanced Generators turn fuels and steam into large amounts of power.
steps: Place a Gas Turbine Controller and connect at least one turbine module to it.
Attach a Fuel Input and an RF Output module to the same connected structure.
Right-click the Controller and correct any missing-module or limit messages.
Confirm the displayed turbine capacity before adding fuel.

goals.text: Fuel a gas turbine and send its power to a machine
goals.hint: Feed fuel into a fuel input and take power from an RF output module.
goals.why: Burns fuels (fire water, rocket fuel ...) for power.
steps: Use the installed fuel recipes to choose an accepted turbine fuel.
Pipe it into the Fuel Input module of the assembled gas turbine.
Connect the RF Output to a machine or energy storage.
Read Controller status to confirm fuel is being consumed and power is delivered.

goals.text: Form a steam turbine and produce power from steam
goals.hint: A steam turbine controller with steam input.
goals.why: Uses steam from heat exchangers or boilers for power.
steps: Connect a Steam Turbine Controller, turbine module, steam input and RF Output.
Provide a steady source of accepted steam through the input.
Connect an energy load and inspect Controller status while the rotor spins up.

goals.text: Use a heat exchanger or syngas machine to produce a useful fluid
goals.hint: Heat exchangers make steam; syngas machines make fuel gas.
goals.why: Makes steam (heat exchanger) or fuel gas (syngas) for your turbines.
steps: Choose the Heat Exchanger or Syngas machine and gather its controller and required modules.
Connect the modules and right-click the Controller to resolve missing requirements.
Provide the recipe inputs and connect empty output storage.
Check the Controller's fluid and production readings, then pipe the product to a compatible turbine.

goals.text: Build a Solar Array Tier 1 Multiblock Structure
goals.hint: Environmental Tech: JEI shows the controller and structure blocks.
goals.why: Environmental Tech solar arrays make lots of power during the day from one controller.
steps: Craft the controller, 16 tier-1 structure blocks, 9 solar cells and 4 modifiers (any modifier block).
Build the layers below around the controller.
Right-click the controller: it says what is missing until the structure is complete.

diagram.title: Solar Array tier 1
diagram.view: K is the controller. Any tier 1-or-higher structure block works.
diagram.note: K = controller. The 9 solar cells sit on top in the middle.

goals.text: Harness the power of Lightning with a Lightning Rod
goals.hint: Lightning rods turn storms into power.
goals.why: Turns thunderstorms into large bursts of power.
steps: Build the lightning rod structure (below) high up, under open sky.
Right-click the controller to check it.

diagram.title: Lightning Rod tier 1
diagram.view: K is the controller. Any tier 1-or-higher structure block works.
diagram.note: Stack the rod straight up above the controller.

goals.hint: A nugget and leather make the strap that holds a jetpack on.
Iron, redstone and a stick make the first jetpack coil.
Redstone, a metal and a coil make a Cell, the jetpack's engine core.
A cell, coil, furnace and metal make a Thruster.
A metal and a cell make a Capacitor that stores energy.
Charge and equip a jetpack, enable its engine and use its flight controls.
goals.why: Real flight once you have power: reach cliffs, build tall things and cross oceans quickly.
goals.tip: Flight speed and capacity depend on the jetpack tier and configuration; check its tooltip.
steps: Craft a jetpack tier and charge it in a compatible FE charger.
Equip it and check the Iron Jetpacks engine and hover keybindings in Controls.
Enable the engine, then hold jump to rise; use hover mode for controlled building.
Land before the energy runs out.

goals.hint: A diamond, redstone and a stick make a stronger coil for better jetpacks.

goals.text: Take flight with a ring or jetpack
goals.hint: A Flight Ring, an Angel Ring or a jetpack lets you fly.
goals.why: Building and exploring get much easier when you can fly.
steps: Craft a flight item and meet its power or equipment requirements shown in its tooltip.
Equip or carry it as required, then enable its flight control.
Fly a short route near the ground and check energy or other ongoing costs before exploring.

goals.text: Use an Angel Block and your ability to fly to build an outpost above a landmark
goals.hint: Angel blocks can be placed in mid-air.
goals.why: Angel blocks can be placed in mid-air: start a sky build anywhere.
steps: Craft angel blocks.
Place one in the air and build on it.

goals.text: Assemble a Create Train between your base and an outpost
goals.hint: Lay track, place a station and assemble a train with controls.
goals.why: Trains carry you and your cargo quickly between bases, farms and mines.
steps: Lay track between two stations.
Build a train on the track with controls and bogeys.
Assemble it at the station.

goals.hint: A sturdy sheet and a brass casing make a Railway Casing.
A railway casing and a compass: a train stop.
A lever, railway casing and precision mechanism: drive the train.
A copper block, gold plate and andesite alloy: makes power from steam.

goals.text: Keep a contraption afloat with Levitite
goals.hint: Crystallize Levitite Blend into Levitite: enough of it keeps a contraption floating without a balloon.
goals.why: Levitite makes compact flying ships and floating platforms without huge balloons, and it resists drifting when you stop.
goals.tip: Levitite cannot be scooped back up once it has crystallized, and blocks used as a mould inside the pool are destroyed. Pearlescent Levitite is a decorative variant.
steps: Crush End Stone with Crushing Wheels into End Stone Powder.
Mix 4 End Stone Powder, 2 zinc nuggets and 500 mB of water in a heated Mechanical Mixer (Blaze Burner under the basin) to get Levitite Blend.

Pour the blend where you want the Levitite (a bucket or spout into a mould of blocks), then heat it: a lit Blaze Burner, campfire or lava next to it starts the crystallization, which spreads through the whole pool.
Build the Levitite into your ship and assemble it. Levitite holds the ship up; propellers still move it and make it climb.

obtain.aeronautics:end_stone_powder: Put End Stone through Create Crushing Wheels (each block gives one powder, sometimes the end stone back too).
obtain.aeronautics:levitite_blend_bucket: Mix 4 End Stone Powder, 2 zinc nuggets and 500 mB of water in a heated Mechanical Mixer, then take the Levitite Blend out of the basin with a bucket (or a spout or pipe).
obtain.aeronautics:levitite: Not crafted: pour Levitite Blend into place and heat it (a lit Blaze Burner, campfire or lava next to it). The fluid crystallizes into Levitite where it stands; once crystallized it cannot be scooped back up.

goals.text: Smelt Draconium Ore into Draconium Ingots
goals.hint: Draconium ore generates in the Overworld (deep), the Nether and the End.
goals.why: Draconic Evolution starts with Draconium: cores, fusion crafting, energy storage.
steps: Find draconium ore (deepslate, Nether or End).
Smelt it into ingots.

goals.hint: Draconium Ore drops Draconium Dust. It smelts to ingots.
A Draconium Ingot, a gold ingot and a diamond make the first core.
Lapis, a diamond and a Draconium Core make the center of the Fusion Crafting setup.
A diamond, a Draconium Core, stone and an iron block. Place injectors around the Crafting Core.
A Fusion Crafting Core with injectors around it crafts Draconic items.
goals.why: All Draconic tools, armor and upgrades are fusion-crafted.
steps: Craft a Fusion Crafting Core and at least 4 Basic Fusion Crafting Injectors (more for big recipes).
Place the injectors facing the core, in line with it, a few blocks away (left/right or above/below).
Put the centre item in the core and the ingredients in the injectors, power the injectors and start the craft.

goals.hint: A Draconium Ingot, a Draconium Core and a Nether Star make a Wyvern Core.
A Draconium Ingot, a redstone block and a Draconium Core.
Nine ingots make a Draconium Block.
A Wyvern Core, a diamond, a Draconium Core and a Draconium Block, fused.
Blaze powder, obsidian and Draconium Dust make Infused Obsidian.
A redstone block, a blaze rod and a Draconium Core.
Nether brick, iron, a furnace and a Draconium Core: a basic generator.
An Energy Pylon feeds an Energy Core from outside.
A diamond and a Particle Generator. Four stabilizers wrap an Energy Core.
A Draconium Ingot, Wyvern Energy Core and Wyvern Core make the core of the energy storage multiblock.
A tool to link crystals together.
A diamond and a Wyvern Energy Core.
A relay crystal split into an input/output crystal.
Ender pearls, an eye, a Particle Generator and a relay crystal.
Strips enchantments to books.
The base of every armor and tool module.
A module core and a clock.
Stores power for your tools.
Fuses a speed module upgrade.
An Elytra and a core give you flight.
A Draconium ingot and a Wyvern Energy Core: a capacitor that charges your items.
Fuse a Wyvern pickaxe with a Wyvern Energy Core.
A sword that carries power.
Armor that carries power.
Teleport to a saved location.
goals.why: Teleport back to a saved location (home, a farm, a portal) from anywhere.
steps: Craft the dislocator.
Sneak-right-click to bind a location; right-click to teleport.

goals.hint: A Dislocator, redstone, iron and a Draconium Ingot pull items to you.
Iron, bars and a Magnet keep your items from being magnetised.
An Ender Pearl and a Wyvern Core.
A pedestal for the Dislocator system.
A powerful food made from supremium essence.
goals.why: A food with strong positive effects (regeneration, resistance and more) for boss fights.
steps: Craft it from supremium essence (recipe below).

goals.hint: Supremium Essence with an Infusion Crystal makes Insanium Essence.
Insanium Essence on farmland grows crops the fastest.
Inferium Essence and a Golden Apple make an apple with a mild effect.
Insanium Essence and a Golden Apple make the strongest apple.
Coal with Inferium Essence burns longer.
A coal that burns for ages.
An axe, pickaxe and shovel in one tool.
Insanium Essence, a Nether Star, Withering Soul and a diamond block make a crux for the Nether Star crop.

goals.text: Defeat the Hydra after completing the Fire Swamp prerequisite
goals.hint: Eat Meef Stroganoff first. Bring fire resistance.
goals.why: The Hydra drops Fiery Blood for Fiery Ingots and is one of the three branches to the Highlands.
steps: Eat Meef Stroganoff.
Find the Hydra lair in the Fire Swamp.
Hit its heads when they open their mouths.

mobs.where: Lives in its lair in the Fire Swamp. Opens after the Minoshroom; eat its Meef Stroganoff first or the swamp sets you on fire.

goals.hint: The Hydra drops juicy chops.
A Hydra drop used to forge fiery metal.
A Ur-Ghast drop used to forge fiery metal.
Fiery blood from the Hydra plus iron makes fiery ingots.
goals.why: Fiery Ingots make Twilight equipment with special burning and smelting effects.
goals.tip: Fiery equipment is not a substitute for a Fire Resistance potion.
steps: Defeat the Hydra for Fiery Blood, or the Ur-Ghast for Fiery Tears.
Combine the appropriate boss drop with iron using its JEI recipe.
Check the equipment tooltip before relying on its protection.

goals.hint: Fiery tools set targets alight.
A set of Fiery armor.

goals.text: Complete Knight Phantom progression in the Dark Forest
goals.hint: The Knight Phantoms guard the Goblin Stronghold, unlocked after the Lich.
goals.why: The Knight Phantoms guard the Goblin Stronghold; beating them opens the Dark Tower.
steps: Complete Lich progression and bring a Twilight boss trophy to the Goblin Knight Stronghold.
Place the trophy on the entrance pedestal to open the shielded entrance.
Find and defeat all six Knight Phantoms.
Collect the reward and check the advancement before approaching the Dark Tower.

obtain.twilightforest:knight_phantom_trophy: Dropped by the last Knight Phantom.

mobs.where: Six Knight Phantoms guard the trophy room of the Goblin Knight Stronghold in the Dark Forest. Opens after the Lich.

goals.hint: A dark stronghold of Knight Phantoms.
Armor Shards drop from the Knight Phantoms.
Knightmetal comes from Armor Shards.
Knightmetal tools hit hard.
A set of Knightmetal armor.
A ring of Knightmetal.
A heavy flail.
Mines huge areas.
A sword that hits hard.

goals.text: Complete Ur-Ghast progression in the Dark Tower
goals.hint: Climb the Dark Tower after the Knight Phantoms.
goals.why: One of the three branches to the Highlands; drops carminite.
steps: Climb the Dark Tower (towerwood); use carminite reactors carefully.
Defeat the Ur-Ghast at the top.

mobs.where: Floats at the top of the Dark Tower in the Dark Forest. Opens after the Knight Phantoms.

goals.hint: A dark tower of Carminite.
A key to the Dark Tower's locked doors.
Destroys any block it touches.
A bow that seeks targets.
A bow that fires three arrows.

goals.text: Complete Alpha Yeti progression in the Snowy Forest
goals.hint: The Alpha Yeti lairs in a snowy cave, unlocked after the Lich.
goals.why: Unlocks the Glacier and the Aurora Palace.
steps: Find the Yeti lair (a snowy cave).
Defeat the Alpha Yeti; dodge the falling ice.

obtain.twilightforest:alpha_yeti_fur: Dropped by the Alpha Yeti in its lair in the Snowy Forest.

mobs.where: Lives in a cave lair in the Snowy Forest. Opens after the Lich.

goals.hint: A cave where the Alpha Yeti lives.
A set of Arctic armor.
A set of Yeti armor.

goals.text: Defeat the Snow Queen in the Aurora Palace
goals.hint: The Aurora Palace is in the Glacier, unlocked after the Alpha Yeti.
goals.why: One of the three branches to the Highlands.
steps: Climb the Aurora Palace in the Glacier.
Defeat the Snow Queen and her ice shields.

mobs.where: Rules the top of the Aurora Palace in the Glacier. Opens after the Alpha Yeti.

goals.hint: A palace of ice.
A very sharp but fragile sword.

goals.text: Complete all three major branches and enter the Highlands
goals.hint: Defeat the Hydra, the Ur-Ghast and the Snow Queen to unlock the Highlands.
goals.why: The Highlands are the last area of the Twilight Forest, with the Troll Caves and the Final Castle.
steps: Defeat the Hydra, the Ur-Ghast and the Snow Queen.
The barrier around the Highlands disappears.

goals.text: Recover the Lamp of Cinders from the Troll Caves
goals.hint: The Troll Caves are in the Highlands; the lamp is in their vaults.
goals.why: The lamp burns away the thorns that block the way to the Final Castle.
steps: Complete the Hydra, Ur-Ghast and Snow Queen progression branches, then explore the Highlands.
Find the Troll Caves and the giant cloud above them.
Obtain the Giant Pickaxe and use it to reach the protected vault in the caves.
Loot the Lamp of Cinders and use it to clear the thorn barrier toward the Final Castle.

obtain.twilightforest:lamp_of_cinders: Found in the troll vault deep in the Troll Caves of the Highlands.

goals.hint: Dark caves in the Highlands.
A bow that teleports you to its arrow.
A set of wearable explorer's items.
The final castle of the Twilight Forest.
Place a beacon with Gaia Pylons around it and use Terrasteel on it, then defeat the Guardian.
goals.why: The Gaia Guardian drops Gaia Spirits, which make Botania's best items: the Gaia ingot, the Ring of the Aesir and endgame flowers.
steps: Build the Beacon base and Gaia Pylon arrangement shown below; compare it with the Lexica Botania ritual preview.
Clear and flatten the surrounding arena so the ritual can validate its fighting space.
Use a Terrasteel Ingot on the Beacon to summon the Guardian.
Stay in the arena, defeat the Guardian and collect its Gaia Spirits.

diagram.title: Gaia arena
diagram.view: Pylons four blocks out on each diagonal, one block higher than the beacon.
diagram.note: Keep 12 blocks around flat and 5 above clear.

mobs.where: You summon it: build the Gaia arena (a beacon on a 3x3 base and 4 Gaia Pylons) and right-click the beacon with a Terrasteel ingot (a Gaia ingot for the harder fight). It cannot be fought on Peaceful.

goals.text: Complete the Ritual of Gaia II
goals.hint: The harder version, started with a Gaia ingot.
goals.why: The harder Gaia fight drops more Gaia spirits and rare loot like the Dice of Fate.
steps: Rebuild the arena.
Use a Gaia Ingot on the beacon instead of Terrasteel.

mobs.where: You summon it: build the Gaia arena (a beacon on a 3x3 base and 4 Gaia Pylons) and right-click the beacon with a Terrasteel ingot (a Gaia ingot for the harder fight). It cannot be fought on Peaceful.

goals.hint: A tiara that lets you fly.
A cloak made with Gaia Spirit.
A talisman that stores huge amounts of one block.
Use a tier 4 Blood Altar and a Common Tartaric Gem to craft the Master Blood Orb.
goals.why: The Master Blood Orb supports higher-tier Alchemy Table recipes and a larger personal LP network.
steps: Follow the tier 4 layout in the Blood Magic guide, using Bloodstone or Bloodstone Bricks as its capstones.
Prepare the Common Tartaric Gem shown in the Master Blood Orb recipe.
Maintain enough LP for the full altar recipe; add capacity or replenish it as the craft runs.
Collect the orb, bind it to yourself and charge the soul network.

goals.hint: A Demonic Slate in a Tier 5 Altar.
A Nether Star in a Tier 5 Altar.
A Greater Gem, an Ethereal Slate, a Nether Star and a diamond block.
An amethyst block, an Ethereal Slate, glowstone and a diamond.
2x2 Crystal Clusters make bricks for the highest altar.
A Crystal Cluster in a Tier 6 Altar: the last orb.

goals.text: Build an efficient LP supply for your Blood Altar
goals.hint: Improve self-sacrifice efficiency and altar capacity, then maintain an LP reserve.
goals.why: A dependable LP reserve supports long altar recipes and your bound Blood Orb. This port does not include the old Well of Suffering ritual.
goals.tip: This is a supply-planning goal, not a claim of passive LP generation. Stop sacrificing well before your health becomes unsafe.
steps: Add available Runes of Self-Sacrifice and capacity upgrades to valid rune positions.
Prepare food and a safe healing source before using the Sacrificial Dagger near the altar.
Fill the altar in controlled amounts and let your health recover between sacrifices.
Charge a bound Blood Orb from the altar, then verify your network balance with the Divination Sigil.

goals.text: Obtain the full Living Armor set
goals.hint: Living Armor grows stronger as you use it.
goals.why: Living Armor levels up as you use it, gaining upgrades like speed and protection.
steps: Craft all four pieces (recipes below).
Wear them and use them.

goals.text: Manage Living Armor upgrade tomes at a Living Station
goals.hint: Store upgrade experience and recover upgrade tomes through the Living Station.
goals.why: Choose and apply upgrade tomes to your Living Armor.
steps: Craft and open the Living Station.
Insert a compatible upgrade tome into its storage input, or use the scrap input for supported conversion.
Select and retrieve a stored upgrade tome.
Use the tome with compatible Living Armor as its tooltip directs, respecting the armor's upgrade budget.

goals.text: Automate the creation of Demonic Slates
goals.hint: Imbued slates in a tier 4 altar become demonic slates.
goals.why: Demonic slates are needed in bulk for tier 5.
steps: Prepare a tier 4 Blood Altar and enough LP for Demonic Slates.
Feed Imbued Slates with controlled item input.
Configure filtered extraction to remove only Demonic Slates, so inputs cannot be pulled out early.
Test one craft before starting a batch, then monitor LP and output space.

goals.hint: Complete the tier 5 rune and capstone layout and verify the tier with a Divination Sigil.
goals.why: Tier 5 unlocks the Archmage Blood Orb and Ethereal Slate recipes available in this port.
steps: Follow the tier 5 rune layout in the Blood Magic guide.
Use Hellforged Blocks for its tier 5 capstones; JEI shows their Hellfire Forge recipe.
Use a Divination Sigil to confirm that the altar recognizes tier 5.
Prepare enough LP supply and capacity before attempting tier 5 recipes.

goals.hint: The Ender Dragon drops a Dragon Heart.
A Draconium Core and a Dragon Heart, fused.
Craft the Awakened Draconium Block back into ingots.
Fuse a Wyvern Core with an Awakened Draconium Ingot.
Awakened Draconium, a Wyvern Energy Core and Wyvern Core.
Draconic armor has a shield that absorbs damage. Made in fusion crafting.
goals.why: The modular chestpiece provides configurable shield and movement abilities when fitted with the right modules and supplied with energy.
steps: Prepare the Wyvern-tier ingredients and Awakened Draconium required by JEI.
Fusion-craft the Draconic Chestpiece with the required injector tier.
Install compatible energy, shield and movement modules, then charge it.
Check the module configuration and energy reserve before a boss fight.

goals.text: Craft the Draconic Pickaxe, Axe, Shovel and Hoe
goals.hint: Upgrade Wyvern tools with awakened draconium in the fusion crafter.
goals.why: Advanced modular tools support configurable mining speed and area effects when charged and fitted with suitable modules.
steps: Craft the Wyvern-tier ingredients required by each JEI recipe.
Use fusion crafting to produce the Draconic tools.
Install suitable energy and tool modules, charge them and configure their working area.
Test a small expendable area before using broad mining modes near your base.

goals.hint: A Draconic sword that loves damage.
A Draconic bow.
A top-tier capacitor for your tools.
Awakened Draconium upgrades the Magnet.
A pickaxe, sword and shovel in one staff.
A huge multiblock battery with stabilizers around it.
goals.why: A huge multiblock battery: millions to billions of FE.
steps: Place the Energy Core and right-click it: its screen can show a holographic build guide.
Build the required blocks around it.
Place 4 stabilizers around it in a cross, aimed at the core, then activate it.

goals.hint: Pump power in until the core is full.
goals.why: The ultimate battery: enough stored power to run a huge base through any shortage.
goals.tip: Total stored FE and production in FE/t are different measurements.
steps: Build and activate an Energy Core at the tier you intend to fill.
Assemble Energy Pylons with their required glass blocks and link them to the core.
Set the feeding pylon to input mode and connect your generators.
Verify the stored energy rises and continue until that core tier is full.

goals.hint: The Chaos Guardian guards a chaos island far out in the End.
goals.why: Chaos shards make chaotic cores, chaotic armor and the strongest Draconic items.
goals.tip: This is a late-game encounter. A Wyvern chestpiece by itself does not establish that your equipment is ready.
steps: Prepare charged Draconic equipment with appropriate shield, energy and mobility modules, plus a return plan.
Find a Chaos Island far out in the End.
Follow the Guardian fight's shield and crystal phases; ordinary attacks cannot bypass every phase.
After victory, collect the Chaos reward and leave promptly before the island's destruction.

mobs.where: The Chaos Guardian lives on a chaos island far out in the End, thousands of blocks from the centre, protected by chaos crystals.

goals.hint: Large, medium and small Chaos Fragments drop from the Guardian.
An Awakened Draconium Ingot, an Awakened Core and a large Chaos fragment, fused.

Feed fuel into the Reactor.

goals.text: Defeat the Chaos Guardian four times
goals.hint: Each chaos island has its own guardian.
goals.why: Repeated Chaos Island victories supply materials for additional chaotic equipment.
steps: Find four different Chaos Islands and defeat their Guardians.
Collect the Chaos rewards and record each victory.
Recharge and replace supplies between fights; do not count returning to an already-cleared island.

goals.text: Craft a Draconic Staff of Power
goals.hint: The ultimate combined mining tool and weapon.
goals.why: A mining tool and a weapon in one, with huge area mining.
steps: Make the Draconic pickaxe, shovel and sword first.
Fusion-craft the staff from them (recipe below).

goals.text: Create an Awakened Fusion Crafting Injector
goals.hint: Upgrade fusion injectors to the Awakened tier for advanced recipes.
goals.why: Higher-tier fusion recipes require a matching injector tier. Awakened is an advanced tier, with Chaotic above it.
steps: Produce Awakened Draconium using the JEI fusion recipe.
Upgrade the required injectors to Awakened tier.
Check both the injector tier and energy cost before starting your next recipe.

goals.text: Create an actively cooled reactor from Extreme Reactors
goals.hint: Coolant ports turn water into steam for a turbine.
goals.why: Active cooling exports reactor heat as steam, allowing a turbine-based power system. Efficiency depends on the complete design.
steps: Build a compatible actively cooled reactor using matching-tier parts.
Fit coolant ports for water input and steam output, and set their directions.
Connect a reliable water supply and a turbine that accepts the steam.
Start the system and check coolant, steam and turbine output; adjust the reactor for its actual load.

Reprocess spent fuel to get Cyanite.

Iron and cyanite make blades.
Iron, a redstone block and an iron block.
A turbine casing, a comparator, a cyanite block and a diamond.
Reprocess Cyanite to Blutonium.

goals.text: Create a turbine from Extreme Reactors
goals.hint: Turbines turn steam into lots of power.
goals.why: Turbines turn steam into a lot of power.
steps: Use the Extreme Reactors guide to assemble a matching-tier casing, Controller, rotor bearing, shaft, blades and induction coil.
Install fluid ports for steam and exhaust/coolant, and a power output.
Resolve Controller assembly messages before connecting steam.
Supply steam, connect an energy load and adjust flow while monitoring rotor speed.

goals.hint: Expand a reinforced reactor to the maximum dimensions permitted by the server configuration.
goals.why: An optional engineering challenge in material supply, assembly and cooling.
goals.tip: Basic and reinforced reactors have different limits. Do not assume an old SkyFactory size applies to this version.
steps: Check the Extreme Reactors guide and the server's configured size limits for the reactor tier.
Plan the outer dimensions, rods, ports and moderator layout before gathering the casing.
Expand in stages and use the Controller to verify the completed structure.
Test its heat and fuel behavior before continuous operation.

goals.text: Use Diamond blocks to cool a maximum-size reactor
goals.hint: Compare diamond-block moderation with your previous cooling layout under the same load.
goals.why: Diamond blocks are a moderator option for comparing reactor heat transfer and fuel efficiency.
goals.tip: More diamond blocks do not automatically mean the best design; rod spacing and cooling matter.
steps: Build and validate your maximum-size reactor first.
Place diamond-block moderator around the fuel rods in the intended interior spaces.
Compare fuel use, temperature and output under the same load and control-rod settings.

goals.text: Build an Extra Utilities Nether Star Generator
goals.hint: Fuel the Netherstar Generator with Nether Stars and route its FE output to storage.
goals.why: Turns costly Nether Stars into machine energy. Its output is FE, not Grid Power.
steps: Craft the Netherstar Generator and place it in a controlled, separated power area.
Connect compatible FE transport and storage.
Insert a Nether Star and check output, fuel consumption and any nearby effects before automating fuel.

goals.text: Generate sustained Grid Power with a Dragon Egg Mill
goals.hint: Use the Dragon Egg Mill for a persistent GP supply.
goals.why: The mill supports GP-consuming utility devices. GP is separate from FE and its output is finite.
goals.tip: The pinned mod advertises 9,999 GP for this mill. That is not 9,999 FE/t and does not power FE machines.
steps: Craft and place the Dragon Egg Mill using its JEI recipe.
Meet its displayed operating requirements and check your GP total.
Connect your GP-consuming utility setup and verify it stays within the available supply.

goals.hint: Build the tier 4 solar array shown below for a larger daytime power supply.
goals.why: A large solar generation milestone using the pack's Environmental Tech recreation.
steps: Craft the tier 4 controller, 40 tier-4 structure blocks, 81 solar cells and 8 modifiers.
Build it as in the picture.
Right-click the controller to check it.

goals.hint: Measure actual combined generation while supplying a load.
goals.why: A power milestone that runs a full early workshop.
goals.tip: This is a production milestone, not stored energy or nameplate capacity. The largest tiers are optional long-term stretch challenges.
steps: Expand your generators and supply all required fuel, cooling or daylight.
Connect storage or a load that can accept the full output; check cable and port limits.
Measure total delivered FE/t without counting the same power twice as it passes through the network.
Maintain 1,000 FE/t long enough to confirm stable operation, then tick the goal.

Measure total delivered FE/t without counting the same power twice as it passes through the network.

Connect storage or a load that can accept the full output; check cable and port limits.
Measure total delivered FE/t without counting the same power twice as it passes through the network.

goals.why: Endgame power for Draconic crafting and big dimensions.
goals.tip: This is a production milestone, not stored energy or nameplate capacity. The largest tiers are optional long-term stretch challenges.
steps: Expand your generators and supply all required fuel, cooling or daylight.
Connect storage or a load that can accept the full output; check cable and port limits.
Measure total delivered FE/t without counting the same power twice as it passes through the network.
Maintain 1 million FE/t long enough to confirm stable operation, then tick the goal.

goals.hint: Measure actual combined generation while supplying a load.
goals.why: The ultimate power challenge, for the bragging rights.
goals.tip: This is a production milestone, not stored energy or nameplate capacity. The largest tiers are optional long-term stretch challenges.
steps: Expand your generators and supply all required fuel, cooling or daylight.
Connect storage or a load that can accept the full output; check cable and port limits.
Measure total delivered FE/t without counting the same power twice as it passes through the network.
Maintain 1 billion FE/t long enough to confirm stable operation, then tick the goal.

goals.hint: Dimlets describe what a dimension contains.
goals.why: Dimlets describe what a custom dimension contains: terrain, biomes, blocks, sky, mobs.
steps: Craft Empty Dimlets using JEI.
Collect the knowledge, essence and feature components required by a specific dimlet recipe.
Use the Dimlet Workbench to assemble that dimlet.
Check its creation and maintenance costs before using it in a dimension.

goals.text: Build a dimension, travel to it, and stay for at least 10 minutes
goals.hint: Enscribe dimlets onto a tab, power the Dimension Builder, then use a matter transmitter.
goals.why: Your own custom world: pick terrain, biomes, ores and sky with dimlets.
steps: Use the Dimension Enscriber to write the selected dimlets onto an Empty Dimension Tab.
Place the tab in a powered Dimension Builder and wait for creation to finish.
Keep the Builder supplied with enough FE to maintain the dimension.
Set up the RFTools dialing and matter-transmitter connection, and carry a charged return method.
Visit for ten minutes while monitoring the dimension's power supply.

goals.text: Use an Absorber to make a custom block dimension
goals.hint: The Block Absorber learns a block for a dimlet.
goals.why: A Block Absorber supplies a component for supported block dimlets; the allowed blocks and costs depend on the dimension system.
steps: Choose a block with a supported dimlet recipe in the Dimlet Workbench.
Place the Block Absorber on a supply of that block and let it reach its required charge.
Use the completed absorber in the dimlet recipe.
Add the dimlet to a dimension design after checking its energy cost.

goals.text: Build a dimension using a rarity-4-or-higher dimlet
goals.hint: Choose a dimlet whose own rarity is at least 4 and use it in a working dimension.
goals.why: A challenge in obtaining rare dimension components and supporting their power costs.
goals.tip: Rarity is a property of dimlets; do not look for a single combined rarity score on a world.
steps: Inspect dimlet tooltips and select one with rarity 4 or higher.
Craft or obtain it through the Dimlet Workbench's supported route.
Enscribe it onto a dimension tab, build the dimension and keep it powered.
Travel there and verify the intended feature.

goals.text: Use a Syringe and the RFTools Spawner to spawn an Ender Dragon
goals.hint: Fill a Syringe from the Ender Dragon, then feed it to an RFTools Spawner with Matter Beamers and power.
goals.why: RFTools Dimensions in this version has no mob dimlets, so the original dragon-dimension challenge became spawning a dragon with RFTools.
goals.tip: A spawned Ender Dragon breaks blocks it flies through and attacks players. Spawn it far from any base, ideally in the End.
steps: Craft a Syringe and hit the Ender Dragon with it until the syringe is full (its tooltip shows the level).
Build an RFTools Spawner and put the full syringe in it.
Feed it matter with Matter Beamers (link each beamer to the spawner with a wrench). The dragon needs End Stone, bottles of enchanting and a lot of other matter.
Give the spawner 100,000 RF per spawn and keep everyone at a safe distance.

goals.text: Collect Ore from the Void with a Void Ore Miner Structure
goals.hint: An Environmental Tech multiblock that pulls ores from the void.
goals.why: An endless supply of ores from a laser that drills into the void.
steps: Craft the controller, structure blocks, machine bases, a laser core and a lens.
Build the layers below (the controller sits on top).
Power it and right-click the controller to check it. A colored lens favours ores of that color.

goals.hint: Over 43 million cobblestone in one block.
goals.why: Over 43 million cobblestone in one block: a test of your automation.
steps: Automate a cobblestone generator into compressors for each level.

goals.text: Get 20 different Chickens and automate resource collection
goals.hint: Breed your way up the chicken tree and roost them all.
goals.why: A collection challenge for chicken breeders.
steps: Breed up the chicken tree (JEI shows parents).
Roost all 20 kinds.

goals.hint: An infusion crystal that never breaks.
goals.why: An infusion crystal that never breaks, so you never need to craft another for Mystical Agriculture.
steps: Craft it (recipe below).

Follow the Mystical Agriculture armor upgrade chain to a full Supremium set.
goals.why: Supremium is a high-tier Mystical Agriculture armor set that supports further augment choices.
steps: Use JEI to follow the armor upgrade chain to Supremium.
Craft or upgrade all four pieces and equip the complete set.
Review available augments and set effects before choosing upgrades.

goals.text: Automate 20 crops with upgraded Ender IO Farming Stations
goals.hint: Fit Farming Stations with Octadic Capacitors, tools, power and twenty supported crops.
goals.why: A mastery build for farm automation.
steps: Choose twenty distinct crop types supported by the Farming Station.
Build and power enough stations, fitting Octadic Capacitors and their required tools.
Supply seeds, reserve replanting stock and collect each crop into labeled storage.
Verify every crop is harvested and replanted without manual transfers.

goals.hint: Construction sticks extend surfaces with blocks from your inventory.
goals.why: Build faster with the netherite construction stick.
steps: Follow JEI through the Construction Stick upgrades to Netherite.
Craft the Unbreakable template and apply it using the displayed upgrade recipe.
Carry matching building blocks and test the stick on a small surface.

goals.text: Craft a melee Tinkers' Weapon that does 20 damage or more
goals.hint: Use strong materials and add damage modifiers such as quartz.
goals.why: A strong weapon for the Twilight and Aether bosses.
steps: Choose a Tinkers weapon and compare its compatible head materials in the Tinkers books.
Build it and apply available damage modifiers such as Sharpness through the required station.
Inspect the finished weapon's attack-damage tooltip and reach at least 20.
Record the base weapon value separately from temporary potion effects.

Build a tool with enough slots and apply the prerequisites in order.
Apply Unbreakable in the required station.
Confirm the finished tool tooltip reports the modifier.

goals.text: Build any melee weapon that does 90 or more damage
goals.hint: Upgrade a compatible late-game melee weapon until its configured attack damage reaches 90.
goals.why: The ultimate weapon challenge.
goals.tip: This is a stretch challenge. Do not assume ordinary Tinkers upgrade slots can reach the target.
steps: Choose a late-game melee weapon with supported damage upgrades, such as a modular Draconic weapon.
Gather and install its compatible damage modules or modifiers, respecting its capacity limits.
Charge it if required and inspect its attack-damage tooltip.
Reach at least 90 attack damage on the configured weapon; record temporary buffs separately.

goals.text: Jump between two tamed dragons while both are flying
goals.hint: A stunt for brave pilots.
goals.why: A stunt for brave pilots (and friends).
goals.tip: This optional cooperative stunt needs two riders; it is not required to unlock equipment or dimensions.
steps: Prepare two tamed, saddled adult dragons and a second rider.
Practice mounting each dragon on the ground, then fly side by side over safe terrain.
Dismount one and mount the other while both remain airborne.
Use fall protection and recover safely before attempting it again.

goals.text: Complete every challenge in this book
goals.hint: Every goal in every group is ticked.
goals.why: A record of completing the book's practical goals and optional mastery challenges.
goals.tip: Completion marks are shared on the server. Only tick activities that your group has actually completed.
steps: Use Hide done to find remaining goals.
Complete their stated objectives, including manual activities and cooperative challenges.
The final goal completes when every other entry is marked done.
